description: The 'dss_agents_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various agents used within a system, capturing essential details such as their names, unique identifiers, types, and versions. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and tracking the lifecycle of agents, including their creation, modification, and deployment. Each agent is associated with a specific project, and the dataset includes information about the project key, which helps in categorizing and organizing agents according to their respective projects. Additionally, the dataset records the large language models (LLMs) utilized by each agent, offering insights into the AI capabilities integrated within the agents. The dataset also tracks the users responsible for creating and modifying the agents, along with timestamps of the last modifications, which is crucial for auditing and change management. Furthermore, the dataset includes URLs for accessing the agents, facilitating easy retrieval and deployment. This dataset is valuable for developers, project managers, and system administrators who need to monitor agent performance, ensure version control, and maintain an organized repository of AI-driven agents.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached agents with details on type, version, and usage.

columns.name: agent_name
columns.comment: Name of the agent, identifies the agent.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each agent, ensures uniqueness.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Key of the project associated with the agent.

columns.name: agent_version
columns.comment: Version of the agent, indicates updates.

columns.name: LLMs_used
columns.comment: List of LLMs used by the agent.

columns.name: creator_user
columns.comment: User who created the agent, tracks origin.

columns.name: last_modified_user
columns.comment: User who last modified the agent, tracks changes.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the agent, for categorization.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of last modification, tracks changes.

columns.name: active_agent_version
columns.comment: Currently active version of the agent.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL link to the agent's location, for access.
